reason: I've had a runny nose for a week and a half.
diagnosis: Likely viral upper respiratory infection/common cold, suggested by persistent clear rhinorrhea after nasal congestion with mild sinus pressure/headache, fatigue, and no fever, cough, purulent discharge, or other concerning symptoms.
keyPoints: Character of discharge and sinus pain/pressure
Associated symptoms: fever, cough, sore throat, dyspnea, loss of taste/smell
COVID exposure/travel and need for testing/isolation
Red flags for bacterial sinusitis or other infection: worsening course, purulent discharge, facial pain, fever
Relevant risk factors: allergies, asthma, smoking, environmental irritants/mold
manner: mildly worried, straightforward, asks for treatment
transcript:
D: Uh, what brings you in here today?
P: Uhm, so I've had this runny nose, well first it was a stuffy nose, but now I've had this runny nose for the past week and a half and it doesn't seem to be getting any better. So I was just wondering if you could give me something for that?
D: Yeah, so yeah, let's just try to first see what's going on. So you've been having this, so when did it start getting stuffy?
P: Uhm, it started getting stuffy about two weeks ago.
D: Two weeks ago, and when did it start getting, like just a runny nose?
P: Yeah, that started a week and a half ago.
D: OK, and have your symptoms, have these symptoms gotten worse at all?
P: No, it stayed about the same.
D: OK and do you have any coughing?
P: No, no coughing.
D: No coughing, uhm, any fevers or chills?
P: No.
D: No, uhm, and the, from the runny nose, are you having any yellow or green discharge?
P: No, it's clear.
D: It's clear, OK. Have you at all coughed up any blood at all?
P: No, nothing like that.
D: OK, and do these symptoms come and go, or are they pretty constant?
P: Uhm, they are pretty constant.
D: OK, and is there anything that you have tried that has helped you with these symptoms? Any over the counter medications?
P: No, I haven't tried anything. I've been thinking about using some nasal decongestion but I don't want to make my runny nose any worse.
D: Yeah, no, that's a, that's a fair point. And yeah, there's multiple things that you can try over the counter, but we can get into that more later. Are you having any other symptoms at all, like any, shortness of breath, chest pain, any kind of dizziness, anything like that?
P: No dizziness, I feel like sometimes I have a headache though, because I feel like there's a lot of fluid or something backed up into my sinuses.
D: OK, so do you, are you feeling, that pressure in your face at all?
P: Mhm, a little bit, yeah.
D: OK. Have you at all in the past couple weeks to a month had contact with anyone that was sick?
P: No, nothing like that, that I can think of.
D: OK and any travel?
P: Uhm, no.
D: OK, and any symptoms of a loss of taste of, sorry, loss of sense of taste or smell?
P: No.
D: No, any nausea or vomiting?
P: Uh, nope.
D: Any night sweats?
P: No.
D: How about fatigue, or do you feel tired?
P: A little bit, yeah.
D: OK, are you, do you work at all?
P: I work from home right now.
D: OK, and has this affected your work in any way?
P: No.
D: OK, uhm, where, where do you live? Do you live in an apartment, a house?
P: I live in an apartment.
D: And do you live with anyone?
P: No, just by myself.
D: OK, and any mold or dust or fumes, anything in your household?
P: I have some old carpets, but that's about it.
D: OK. Have you felt any changes in your sleep or appetite?
P: No, nothing like that.
D: OK. Any changes in your bowel movement, like diarrhea or Constipation?
P: No.
D: Any urinary trouble?
P: No.
D: Any weight loss?
P: No.
D: OK. Do you have any past medical conditions that you've been diagnosed with, like asthma or anything else?
P: Uhm, no, I'm healthy otherwise.
D: OK, any allergies that you know of?
P: Uh, nope, no allergies either.
D: OK. Do you take any regular medications?
P: Uh no, I don't even take vitamins.
D: OK. Any hospitalizations or surgeries in the past?
P: I had an arm fracture when I was younger, but that's it.
D: OK, but other than that, nothing else?
P: No.
D: OK. And currently right now, do you smoke cigarettes at all?
P: No.
D: Have you smoked in the past?
P: No.
D: Any recreational drugs like marijuana?
P: No.
D: OK. And do you drink alcohol?
P: Once in a while I'll have like a glass of wine every week.
D: OK. And yeah, those are pretty much all the questions I have right now. Do you have any questions?
P: Uh, no, what can I do about this runny nose?
